method: Executed through the integrated Chromium browser and Playwright tools against the generated static build.
hosting_claim: Root and nested-folder static delivery verified locally; an actual Rumahweb account was not accessed.

checks.observed: Target A at the 20-degree preset returns NO_MODELED_ROUTE with null time, without changing the preset.
Custom row 70, column 37 returns FEASIBLE under the unchanged nominal parameters.
Editing an input clears the previous result and sets the status to STALE before recalculation.
Adding 63 min changes the witness result to TIME_BUDGET_EXCEEDED, margin -1.0830014565751185 min.
A science-only change reports cached route search reused.
Manually changing the slope limit to 25 degrees rebuilds the search; target A becomes FEASIBLE with margin 37.44801268475368 min.
The same application, worker, and real data load at /nested/homebound/; the original nominal 20-degree preset is restored.
A direct worker request with zero speed yields an explicit error response with code INVALID_INPUT, not a plan result.
At 390 x 844 CSS pixels, document width does not exceed viewport width.
The generated export Blob was read through temporary test instrumentation: valid JSON; width 300; Mars radius 3396036.8126024 m; complete 41-cell return route.
Optical and qualitative thermal selections produce different canvas images; the opportunity overlay is restored.
Decision and map screenshots captured with a requested 1440 x 1100 viewport; the embedded page reported an actual 1015 x 775 CSS viewport. This distinction is not hidden.

limitations: The integrated browser did not expose a native download event. OS-level save/download behavior is not claimed as tested. The actual generated Blob content was validated independently of that event.

Direct fetch of a Blob URL was blocked by the application's intentional self-only connect-src policy. The production CSP was not weakened; temporary test instrumentation captured the generated Blob and was removed.
The intentional invalid-input worker test emits an expected console error. This is not recorded as an unexpected application failure.
No real astronaut, planetary analog, physiological, mission-safety, or human-factors validation was performed.
